examples.text: A passport identifies you as a citizen of a country and allows you to travel to foreign countries.
I was asked to show my passport at the border.
She was in trouble because she lost her passport.

en: long strip of cloth or paper used for decoration or advertising
cn: 旗帜

examples.text: If you want to put your banner on my site, just send me the code.
Like the banner, the design was based around the colour white.
The one holding a banner is waving it.

en: involving risk or danger
cn: 危险的, 冒险的, 碰运气的

examples.text: He makes a lot of money including the hazardous duty pay, but the work is very dangerous.
Based on a true story, the film aims to entertain but also to increase awareness about how hazardous chemicals pose a threat to public health.
The growing number of potholes is making cycling increasingly hazardous.

en: a chemical substance that undergoes a rapid chemical change (with the production of gas) on being heated or struck
cn: 炸药, 爆破音

examples.text: All oil-rich countries have to be bombarded with depleted uranium explosives to guarantee democracy and freedom for their people.
For detecting drugs or hidden explosives, there's no technology that can match a dog's nose.
Our brave servicemen have crossed thousands of miles to drop tons of explosives on the heads of these innocent children to defend peace.

en: throw or cast away
cn: 丢弃, 抛弃

examples.text: Remember to check for any expired condiments and discard them.
It's not easy to discard a bad habit.
I usually discard the green part of the scallion, but my mom uses the whole thing.

en: a solemn pledge (to oneself or to another or to a deity) to do something or to behave in a certain manner
cn: 誓约, 誓言, 许愿

examples.text: If I wanted to stop speaking to all the people I despise, I would have to take a vow of silence.
With every broken vow, you bring our ideal closer to destruction.
I have made a vow never to get married.

en: a lamp that produces a strong beam of light to illuminate a restricted area; used to focus attention of a stage performer
cn: 照明灯, 反光灯, 聚光灯

examples.text: It's hard for me to always be in the spotlight.
When will I get my chance in the spotlight?
They prefer the shadows rather than the spotlight.

en: an endorsement made in a passport that allows the bearer to enter the country issuing it
cn: 签证

examples.text: I had a valid visa, so I was allowed to enter the country.
I need a visa to enter that country.
You need to hand in a few photos, fill in a form, and get a visa.

en: an unhealthy and compulsive preoccupation with something or someone
cn: 困扰, 困扰人的情绪

examples.text: I suggest that you start a behavioral therapy in order to cure yourself of your obsession with comas.
I've gotten wary of the gleam in your eye that shows when you've developed a new obsession.
I'm not about to throw away my life just because some maniac has a psychopathic obsession with sitting on a throne.

en: intense feelings of suffering; acute mental or physical pain
cn: 极大的痛苦, 挣扎

examples.text: He wrung his hands in an agony of apprehension, and swayed backwards and forwards in his chair.
He lay in agony until the doctor arrived.
The agonies of the machine age do not originate from the machines as such.

en: a package of several things tied together for carrying or storing
cn: 捆, 束

examples.text: She bought a bundle of firewood, some wholemeal bread, some flour low in quality, and some milk.
The books were tied up in a bundle.
He went out carrying a bundle of clothing.

en: two-winged insect whose female has a long proboscis to pierce the skin and suck the blood of humans and animals
cn: 蚊子

examples.text: If you think you are too small to make a difference, try sleeping with a mosquito.
I don't know whether I got this bite from a midge or a mosquito.
This issue is an elephant, but the politicians pretend that it's a mosquito.

en: suspicious or unduly suspicious or fearful of being displaced by a rival
cn: 嫉妒的, 羡慕的, 留心的, 戒备的

examples.text: You must not be jealous of others' success.
He was sick of being vilified all the time by people who were jealous of his ability.
A jealous person gets a feeling of contentment by behaving like a dog in the manger even with his friends.

en: a place of refuge and comfort and security
cn: 港, 避难所

examples.text: A ship in the harbor is safe, but that is not what ships are built for.
With a blow of the whistle, the ship began to pull away from the harbor.
The container ship kept station outside the harbor until the pilot boat arrived.

en: a brief report (especially an official statement issued for immediate publication or broadcast)
cn: 公告, 布告, 公报

examples.text: See the evening news bulletin for a report about this.
We interrupt this program to bring you a special news bulletin.
The new constitution will also be published in a bulletin.

en: a low area where the land is saturated with water
cn: 湿地, 沼泽地

examples.text: A wetland is an area of land that is saturated with water.
The mangrove ecosystem is a unique type of wetland that is adapted to brackish water.
The loss of wetlands through human activities such as land development is a major concern for conservationists.

en: causing or capable of causing harm
cn: 有害的, 伤害的

examples.text: There's a chance that tap water may contain harmful substances like chlorine and lead.
The stress caused by worrying about the disease may be more harmful than the disease itself.
These light bulbs need to be recycled because they contain mercury and are harmful to the environment.

en: fill with terror; frighten greatly
cn: 使恐惧, 恐吓

examples.text: The child who delights in her jack-in-the-box may have been terrified the first time the puppet-on-a-spring popped out.
Suddenly, amid all the hubbub of the gale, there burst forth the wild scream of a terrified woman.
Scarcely had they closed their eyes than the terrifying cry of a panther rang out from the jungle behind them.

en: a small restaurant where drinks and snacks are sold
cn: 咖啡馆, 酒店

examples.text: Is there a cafe where I can have a light meal?
I am entering the cafe to get something to drink.
The rain stopped just long enough for me to dash into the cafe without getting wet.

en: a common nonmetallic element that is normally a colorless odorless tasteless inert diatomic gas; constitutes 78 percent of the atmosphere by volume; a constituent of all living tissues
cn: 氮

examples.text: Of all gases, nitrogen is the most abundant in the atmosphere.
The atmosphere mostly consists of nitrogen and oxygen.
Too much nitrogen is just as harmful as too little.

en: controlling influence
cn: 摇摆, 影响力, 支配

examples.text: The sway of alcohol over mankind is unquestionably due to its power to stimulate the mystical faculties of human nature.
Though he is no longer president, he still holds considerable sway among the political elite.
The palm leaves sway in the wind that is blowing from the sea.

en: feel bitter or indignant about
cn: 愤恨, 憎恶, 怨恨

examples.text: She hinted that he was of a stern and unforgiving character, more ready to resent than to pardon injuries.
If you keep harping on his flaws, he'll grow to resent you.
I resent the dentist who hurt my teeth.

en: learn or discover with certainty
cn: 确定, 查明

examples.text: I am going to ascertain the truth of the matter.
I'm going to ascertain the truth of his statement.
It is difficult to ascertain what really happened.

en: marked by keen caution and watchful prudence
cn: 谨慎的, 小心的, 机警的, 周到的, 唯恐的

examples.text: Be wary of the man that knows little, and doesn't know it.
My parents always told me to be wary of strangers.
One ought to be wary of "false friends" in translation.

en: works for an expert to learn a trade
cn: 学徒, 生手

examples.text: After fifth grade in primary school I would spend my summer vacations as their apprentice.
The seaman apprentice, sitting on a stool in a bar, ordered a beer while waiting for his basket of fish and chips.
We'd like to take on more apprentices, but unfortunately we can't find any.

en: a passage selected from a larger work
cn: 摘录

examples.text: The following passage is an excerpt from a well-known fairy story.
I would say that a verse is a structural unit, whereas a passage or excerpt can consist of parts of multiple verses or a small part of a verse.
The students have to analyze an excerpt from the book.

en: the action of an armed force that surrounds a fortified place and isolates it while continuing to attack
cn: 包围, 围攻, 再三的努力

examples.text: During the siege, the trapped soldiers made a daring sortie to break through the enemy lines.
During the siege, zoo animals regularly ended up on restaurant menus.
The siege of the fortress lasted a long time.

en: a preschool for children age 4 to 6 to prepare them for primary school
cn: 幼稚园

examples.text: A preschooler learns many skills to prepare them for kindergarten.
The teacher of the kindergarten told the pupils to respect, and cherish each other.
There was a lot of traffic on the road in front of the kindergarten.

en: money granted (by a university or foundation or other agency) for advanced study or research
cn: 伙伴关系, 共同参与, 团体, 奖学金, 友谊

examples.text: And have no fellowship with the unfruitful works of darkness, but rather reprove them.
I bid you greetings and may there be peace through fellowship between us.
No people on earth can be held, as a people, to be an enemy, for all humanity shares the common hunger for peace and fellowship and justice.

en: a liquid substance capable of dissolving other substances
cn: 溶剂

examples.text: An aqueous solution is one where water is the solvent.
Can I use this solvent to dilute my sample?
My responsibility is to keep the company solvent.

en: related to or dealing with or devoted to archaeology
cn: 考古学的, 考古学上的

examples.text: The building work's got to be stopped immediately so that archaeological excavations can be carried out.
The artifact discovered at the archaeological site should be treated with utmost care.
It is an ancient midden, presently an archaeological treasury.

en: a document certifying the successful completion of a course of study
cn: 文凭, 毕业证书

examples.text: I finished the course, but they didn't give me the diploma.
I went to college for four years and all I got was this lousy diploma.
What kind of a job do you think you can get with this diploma?

en: become worse or disintegrate
cn: (使)恶化

examples.text: Without water, sanitation and hygiene standards in the hospitals deteriorate.
With the deteriorating ethos, even seemingly trivial matters have caused a further degeneration of the situation.
What was supposed to be a targeted military operation deteriorated into wholesale slaughter of civilians.

en: receptacle that holds odds and ends (as sewing materials)
cn: 椅子的背罩, 装杂物的容器

examples.text: Remember that a clean apron not only protects your clothes but also keeps you looking tidy.
Involve yourself in choosing storage solutions that suit your needs and keep your room tidy.
It's important to keep your room tidy for a fresh and organized environment.

en: a woman waiter
cn: 女侍者, 女服务员

examples.text: The waitress bought a new cellphone and she's shown it to all her regular customers.
The waitress found a new job at the new restaurant down the street.
One of his sons became a butcher and the other one a waitress.

en: being unoccupied
cn: 空, 空白, 空缺, 空虚, 空闲

examples.text: Bring me your resume. I told you there's a vacancy at my office.
I understand there has been a recent vacancy in your store.
His resignation left a vacancy in the cabinet.

en: in accordance with convention or custom
cn: 习惯的, 惯常的

en: the branch of physics that studies celestial bodies and the universe as a whole
cn: 天文学

en: low-lying wet land with grassy vegetation; usually is a transition zone between land and water
cn: 沼泽, 湿地

examples.text: From the marsh at the head of the pond came the clear, mournfully-sweet chorus of the frogs.
The knight entered the marsh, not knowing that the nagas had already seen him.
The last and least pleasant part of the journey was through the marsh.

en: a journey taken for pleasure
cn: 远足, 游览圆, 短程旅行

examples.text: Because tomorrow is a holiday from school, we plan to go on an excursion.
Six of us are going on an excursion to the beach this weekend.
If it should rain tomorrow, the excursion will be canceled.

en: a shop where books are sold
cn: 书店

examples.text: If I can get a book from the library, it saves me the need to buy it in the bookshop.
He took his books to a second-hand bookshop; they were just taking up space.
I bought this book at the bookshop in front of the station.

en: substantially made or constructed
cn: 强健的, 健全的

examples.text: My new can opener is sturdier than the old one, so hopefully it won't take 2 minutes to get at my beans anymore.
Let's find out which paper towel is the sturdiest.
A concrete structure will usually be sturdier than a wooden one.

en: device that heats water or supplies warmth to a room
cn: 加热器, 灯丝, 加热工

examples.text: The hot water heater is acting up again, so you'll have to wait a bit before taking a shower.
This heater won't heat up that large room.
An insulated soft-wood room and a good heater are the absolute necessities for a sauna.

en: laugh nervously
cn: 吃吃地笑, 咯咯地笑

examples.text: All the kids laughed and even the teacher giggled.
A cute kitten can make a giggling mess even out of the most severe übermensch.
Giggling with embarrassment, she held out the condom.

en: a humming noise
cn: 嗡嗡声, 哼声, 杂声

examples.text: The hum of mating males has been likened to the buzz of a chain saw.
Their journey was silent but for the hum of the engine, the hiss of the rain and the rhythmic squeaking of the windshield wipers.

en: not convinced
cn: 可疑的, 不确定的

examples.text: Her attraction was dubious even after the second glass of wine.
There is a highly dubious award for particularly dog-hating acts.

en: a remark (or act) expressing praise and admiration
cn: 称赞, 恭维, 敬意

examples.text: It was meant as a compliment, so I didn't want to tell him that he had missed the point.
In some cultures, a resounding belch after a meal is considered a compliment to the chef.
I do not know whether to take it as a compliment or an insult.

en: a severe shortage of food (as through crop failure) resulting in violent hunger and starvation and death
cn: 饥荒, 缺乏, 饥饿

examples.text: For the famine shall consume all the land, and the greatness of the scarcity shall destroy the greatness of the plenty.
In the days when the judges judged, there was a famine in the land.
If the harvest gets any worse, there could be a famine.

en: a localized and violently destructive windstorm occurring over land characterized by a funnel-shaped cloud extending toward the ground
cn: 旋风, 龙卷风, 大雷雨

examples.text: The sailors saw how a giant tornado suddenly formed near them, and they started to row the other way in fear.
My heart will always go out to the families that lost their loved one in that tornado.

en: make simpler or easier or reduce in complexity or extent
cn: 单一化, 简单化

examples.text: The proposal has not been fully agreed upon. I propose to simplify it.

The sentence shows a complete lack of agreement. I propose to simplify it.

en: the activity of flying a glider
cn: 滑动, 滑过, 流水

examples.text: She watched the nib of her pen glide around the surface of the page, an inky line trailing behind it.
When the morning's first streetcar announces its arrival and glides smoothly up to the stop, there are many already standing and waiting there.

en: cause to be embarrassed; cause to feel self-conscious
cn: 使困窘, 使局促不安, 阻碍

examples.text: She was very embarrassed when her child behaved badly in public.

en: a gender that refers chiefly (but not exclusively) to males or to objects classified as male
cn: 阳性, 男性

en: any of various substances of either mineral origin or plant or animal origin; they are solid at normal temperatures and insoluble in water
cn: 蜡, 蜡状物, 一阵发怒, 增加, (月亮)渐盈

en: an animal or plant that lives in or on a host (another animal or plant); it obtains nourishment from the host without benefiting or killing the host
cn: 寄生生物, 寄生虫, 食客

examples.text: A fetus is a parasite, and if it weren't for the placenta protecting it, the mother's body would treat it as such.

en: existing or living or growing or operating in the air
cn: 空中的, 航空的, 空气的, 空想的

examples.text: The mercenaries spied a military aircraft conducting aerial reconnaissance over the area.

The town was subjected to an aerial attack.

en: turn on or around an axis or a center
cn: (使)旋转, 反复考虑, 循环出现

en: excessively agitated; distraught with fear or other violent emotion
cn: 狂乱的, 疯狂的

en: not in action or at work
cn: 懒惰的, 闲散的, 停顿的, 空闲的, 无用的

cn: 近郊, 市郊

en: one celestial body obscures another
cn: 日食, 月食, (地位名誉等的)消失

en: someone who has insufficient assets to cover their debts
cn: 破产者

en: become faint or more distant

cn: 使恼怒, 骚扰

en: a lever that is operated with the foot
cn: 踏板, 脚蹬子

en: a piece of furniture that stands at the side of a dining room; has shelves and drawers

en: a slowly moving mass of ice
cn: 冰川

en: a small bed that folds up for storage or transport
cn: 行军床, 小屋, (家畜等的)棚, (家畜等的)栏

en: of or relating to the armed forces

en: a steep descent of the water of a river

en: a person or animal that is markedly unusual or deformed
